$comment: Usage notes for the published design system, keyed by token name.
HAND-WRITTEN. Everything else about tokens.json is generated from
_tokens.scss: the names, the values, the theme pairing. Only this text is
here, because the source comments explain groups ('Neutral ramp — anchored
at 500 on the brand grey') while the design system wants a sentence per
token telling a reader when to reach for it.
Every token in _tokens.scss needs an entry. build-tokens-json.mjs --check
fails on one that has none, which is what stops a new token reaching the
tw-brand: The identity grey of the avatar and the favicon. Fixed across themes: it is the mark, not a UI colour. Never use it for text.
tw-neutral-900: Darkest step of the ramp. The dark theme's page ground.
tw-neutral-850: The dark theme's card and panel surface.
tw-neutral-800: The dark theme's raised surface, one step above a card.
tw-neutral-750: Ramp step between the raised surface and the control ground.
tw-neutral-700: The dark theme's control ground: buttons, inputs, chips.
tw-neutral-650: Hairlines and dividers on a dark ground.
tw-neutral-500: The midpoint, identical to the brand grey. The whole ramp is anchored here so the mark and the interface share one family.
tw-neutral-300: Muted text on a dark ground.
tw-neutral-200: The light theme's control ground, and hairlines on a light ground.
tw-neutral-050: The light theme's card and panel surface.
tw-bg: The page ground. Every contrast figure in this system is measured against this or against tw-surface.
tw-surface: Cards, panels and the nav bar: one step off the page ground.
tw-surface-raised: Menus, dialogs and anything that sits above a card.
tw-control-bg: The ground under buttons, inputs and chips. Pair it with tw-control-text, never with tw-accent.
tw-control-text: Foreground on tw-control-bg: 5.11:1 dark, 4.95:1 light. Controls get their own foreground because tw-accent only reaches 3.79:1 on the control ground.
tw-text: Body text on tw-bg: 5.67:1 dark, 5.78:1 light. The brand blue, darkened for the light theme.
tw-text-dim: Secondary text. Dark is 3.93:1, so on a dark ground use it at 24px or above only; light is 7.09:1 and unrestricted.
tw-text-muted: Captions, metadata and labels that must recede without disappearing.
tw-accent: The burnt orange, on the page ground only: 5.22:1 dark, 5.64:1 light. On a control ground use tw-control-text.
tw-accent-hover: The accent under pointer or focus: 7.01:1 dark, 4.52:1 light.
tw-link: Inline links on the page ground: 7.04:1 dark, 5.64:1 light.
tw-success: A completed or valid state. Always pair it with a word or an icon, never colour alone.
tw-warn: A caution that does not block the reader.
tw-danger: A failure or a destructive action. Pair it with a word, never colour alone.
tw-glass-bg: The translucent ground of the frosted nav bar, used together with tw-glass-blur.
tw-glass-blur: The backdrop-filter radius of the frosted nav bar: backdrop-filter: blur(var(--tw-glass-blur)). A blur radius, not a spacing step, so it is not on the 4px grid.
tw-font-sans: The one brand family: self-hosted Roboto, with a system fallback. There is deliberately no mono token.
tw-weight-light: Display text only. One of the three weights with a shipped font face.
tw-weight-medium: Headings, buttons and labels. The heaviest face that ships; never ask for 600 or 700.
tw-text-xs: Captions, token names and the wordlist output.
tw-text-sm: Labels, table cells and secondary interface text.
tw-text-base: Body copy. The base of the ramp.
tw-text-lg: Section headings, and the reading size the site sets on its prose.
tw-text-2xl: Display text: the largest size the brand sets.
tw-leading-tight: Headings and display text. Unitless, so it scales with the size it lands on.
tw-leading-normal: Interface text: labels, buttons, table cells.
tw-space-1: The base step. Gaps inside a control, between an icon and its label.
tw-space-2: Padding inside compact controls; the gap between related items in a row.
tw-space-3: The gap between navigation links, and padding in medium controls.
tw-space-4: Card padding and the page's side gutter.
tw-space-6: The gap between blocks inside a section.
tw-space-10: The largest step: the space around a page's main region.
tw-radius-sm: Chips, tags and other small surfaces.
tw-radius-md: The default: buttons, inputs and cards.
